__doc: Floors per tranche for run-stage.js --gate, as ratios: the share of vuln samples whose vulnerable lines an analyzer flagged, and the share of noise samples left quiet.

Calibrated 2026-10-16 with betterleaks 1.8.1 (the version docker/Dockerfile pins) and the secret scan on (the dependency scan has nothing to read: the corpus holds no lockfiles). Two runs each, identical sample by sample: vuln 6 of 66 (the six planted credentials; the 60 published advisories carry none, and the scan raised nothing on them), noise 14 of 14. No model: floor = observed, so one sample lost fails.
Deliberate break: production's SecretScanTool.selectFiles returning no file: vuln 0 of 66, gate red (exit 1).
RATCHET: a PR that moves a value on purpose (a tool, its version, the corpus) recalibrates here in the same PR, with its runs as evidence.
